title: Resilient Backend & Developer API Infrastructure
summary: Design and build production-grade application backends and public Developer API Ecosystems built to survive scale.

problem.headline: Fragile APIs & Unmanaged Webhook Failures
points: Public API endpoints breaking under concurrent traffic spikes.
Dropped webhooks causing state desynchronization between systems.
Lack of distributed rate-limiting and public API key lifecycle management.

approach.headline: Decoupled Service Layers & Transactional Outboxes
points: Implement transactional outbox engines to guarantee zero-drop webhook delivery.
Build framework-agnostic TypeScript service layers decoupled from API frameworks.
Enforce distributed rate limiting using Redis token-bucket algorithms.

deliverables: Production-ready OpenAPI v3 specification & interactive portal
Distributed Rate Limiter & API key rotation middleware
